seeds.why: Pre-#1262 adopt_partition: no isolation level is refused, so under REPEATABLE READ or SERIALIZABLE every read after the partition's lock (attached and not pending, the name, the bounds) goes through the transaction's first snapshot. A DETACH another session committed before the call is read as still attached and the standalone table is recorded in pgpm.part as a partition; a RENAME is recorded under the old name. One site, the refusal's condition. tests/332 parts A, B and C catch it.
